name.full: Contoso Payroll Agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot

description.short: Process payroll from your open timesheet in Copilot.
description.full: A declarative agent from Contoso Payroll (a fictional payroll ISV) that turns an open timesheet into a processed pay period — gross, taxes and deductions to net pay, pre-flight compliance checks, and employer tax summaries — powered by a custom, authenticated MCP server. Figures are illustrative, not tax advice.
